app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:118 — -ms-align-items` is not a real IE10/11 flexbox property (the correct old syntax is `-ms-flex-align`, already present on the prior line), so this declaration is dead/no-op code copy-pasted into the mixin

goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
-ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
-webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `@include order(2);` added to `.extra-info-wrapper` in `topic.scss`, but it does not show the surrounding/layout context (i.e., the parent selector’s `display:flex` or lack thereof). The finding asserts a specific parent/sibling relationship ("top-level `.extra-info-wrapper`, sibling of `#topic-title`") and that the parent is not flex, neither of which is verifiable from the provided diff hunks. Therefore the claim that `order` is dead code cannot be confirmed from the diff alone.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:280 — padding: 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` was replaced with `padding: 0 1.5%` on `.small-action-desc`; the large left padding (4em) was presumably reserved to clear the floated `.topic-avatar`, and removing it while the avatar is still floated (see above) can cause the description text to overlap the avatar icon.

adjudication.rationale: The finding assumes `.topic-avatar` is still floated and that `.small-action-desc` needs large left padding to clear it. In the diff, `.small-action` is changed to a flex container (`@include flexbox(); @include align-items(center);`), which typically replaces the need for float-clearing padding because its children become flex items (and `float` would have no effect on flex items). The diff does not show any `float` on `.topic-avatar` within `.small-action`, so the claimed overlap due to a remaining float is not verifiable from the shown changes.
